spanish: Y su minjá sólet mezclada en el aceite: tres décimos al toro el uno, a los trece toros; dos décimos al carnero el uno, a los dos carneros.

findings.issue: minjá leaves the common noun (H4503) untranslated; it is not a locked proper name
sólet leaves the common noun (H5560) untranslated
los makes the thirteen bulls definite; the preposition, the cardinal, and פָּרִים have no article

notes: Counts, el uno, and the definite two rams match the tokens.
